svg.title: A survey rehearsal, read through its panels
svg.desc: Three rows show preparation, observation and recovery, with actual firmware-rendered thumbnails. This is an annotated route through selected states, not the executable state machine.

g.text: A survey rehearsal, read through its panels
Selected milestones • code-rendered panels • illustrative route, not an autonomous flight policy
The home view comes into sight.
A return may branch from observation. Uncertainty can loop through CHECK, DOUBT and SCAN.
